connector.name: Boyce
connector.registryDescription: Deterministic SQL compiler for AI agents. Your agent stops guessing SQL.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package boyce. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the boyce-io account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BOYCE_DB_URL
env.description: PostgreSQL or Redshift connection string. Optional — tools work without live DB; required for live profiling and EXPLAIN pre-flight.

env.name: BOYCE_PROVIDER
env.description: LLM provider for the NL→StructuredFilter planner (anthropic, openai). MCP hosts using their own model should not set this — the host's model does the reasoning and Boyce receives a pre-built StructuredFilter.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Required only when BOYCE_PROVIDER=anthropic and the host does not supply its own model. MCP hosts (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Cline, Windsurf, JetBrains) do not need this.
